decisionRules.stopConfirmed: L3 triplet calendar-complete + max leg implied < 1.5 km/h → STOP_STRICT (no numeric speed emitted).
decisionRules.stopV2Aligned: Existing STATIONARY_SUPPORTED + STATIONARY_BAND + TRUSTED_LIMITED → STOP_V2_BAND (extends V2, not parallel product path).
decisionRules.creep: Leg implied 1.5–5 km/h without V2 band — CREEP (never upgraded to STOP).
decisionRules.unknownGap: ROW_ABSENT / incomplete ±1s / NO_MOTION_EVIDENCE — UNKNOWN_GAP; max 2s gap bridging not applied across absent runs.
decisionRules.moving: Numeric L3 ≥ 5 km/h or S1 MOVING_SPEED_ESTIMATED.
decisionRules.persistence: Repeated coordinates in hold runs do not refresh stop evidence (hold-release classifier); missing rows do not extend stop claims.
